market_question: Abstract FDV above $200M one day after launch?
reasoning: Abstract is a prominent Ethereum L2 with strong brand (Pudgy Penguins) and VC backing. A token launch by the 2027 deadline is almost certain, and comparable L2 tokens have debuted far above $200M FDV. Even allowing for airdrop selling pressure, one-day FDV is very likely to stay above $200M.
evidence_points: Major L2 tokens (Arbitrum, Starknet, Blast) have launched with FDVs in the billions, making $200M a very low bar.
Abstract's team and community drive high pre-launch hype, suggesting strong initial valuation.
Failure to launch a token by end of 2027 is unlikely given project momentum.
sources_consulted: general crypto market knowledge on L2 launches
